Team — heads up, spotted an anomaly in this morning's forecast sweep: BrightForge (RF-4821) is showing as COMMITTED in HubSpot but the price concession on the term sheet is not yet approved by Deal Desk.

Quick facts:
- ACV on the COMMIT row: $195,000 annual
- Quoted discount: 28% (applied in CRM) — no Deal Desk ruling attached
- Expected close date: 2026-07-20 (customer engineering sign-off)

This will materially inflate July committed totals if left as-is. Can Deal Desk / Finance confirm whether the discount is approved or if we should move this back to "Commit: pending pricing"?

Actions requested:
1) Laura / Marcus: can you flag the CRM stage and hold the revenue until pricing is signed off?
2) Vanessa: can Finance provide a quick ruling or temporary treatment for forecast reporting?
3) Grace (cc'd): if BrightForge still needs a concession, please confirm the business justification and minimal term changes we can offer so we can expedite approval.

I've attached the current term sheet extract and a pipeline snapshot. Will follow up in 48 hrs if we don't have a decision.

Thanks,

A couple notes from our side: the 28% discount was requested to meet our pilot budget — we can do a shortened pilot window (6 months) or slightly tighter usage caps to reduce discount need. Sorry for the delay — reviewed RF-4821 with Deal Desk and Finance.

Summary of ruling:
- Full 28% concession is NOT approved (goes beyond our standard concession band for first-year pilots).
- Approved concession: 15% flat (applies to year 1 only) plus the option for a 6-month pilot term capped at agreed usage thresholds.
- Treatment for forecast: treat the deal as "Commit — conditional (partial concession granted)" for July reporting. Only 60% of the quoted ACV should be counted toward July committed totals until a fully signed contract is in place.

Attachments: DealDesk_Ruling_BF4821.pdf (signed review, 2 pages).

Next steps:
1) Priyom — please update HubSpot to reflect the conditional commit and revise the quoted discount to 15% in the line items.
2) Laura — we'll post a note in finance ledger for July to apply the 60% counting rule; update will be reflected in the Monday forecast refresh.
3) If BrightForge sends an updated term sheet tonight we can expedite final approval.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Revenue Finance | Redwood Inference
